title: Daily Devotional #27
paragraphs: As I read through Matthew chapter 27, I am overwhelmed with emotions. This chapter recounts the betrayal, trial, crucifixion, and burial of your son, Jesus Christ. It is one of the most painful and heartbreaking moments in human history.

The chapter starts with the betrayal of Jesus by Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples. Judas betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver, which was the price of a slave. It is hard to imagine how someone who walked so closely with Jesus could betray him for such a small amount of money.

Then, Jesus is brought before the high priest and the Sanhedrin for trial. The religious leaders accuse him of blasphemy and seek to put him to death. Despite the false accusations and the mockery, Jesus remained silent, knowing that his mission was to die for the sins of humanity.

The chapter goes on to describe the brutal crucifixion of Jesus. He was mocked, beaten, and nailed to a cross. He endured excruciating pain and suffering for hours before finally giving up his spirit and dying. It is hard to fathom the depth of love that Jesus had for us to endure such agony.

Lastly, we read about the burial of Jesus. Joseph of Arimathea, a member of the Sanhedrin, took Jesus' body and placed it in his own tomb. This fulfilled the prophecy that Jesus would be buried with the rich.

As I reflect on this chapter, I am reminded of the immense sacrifice that Jesus made for us. He willingly gave up his life so that we could be reconciled to you, God. He suffered so that we could have eternal life. This chapter is a reminder of the price that was paid for our salvation.
Lord, I pray that I never take for granted the sacrifice that was made for me. Help me to live a life that honors you and the gift of salvation that you have given us through Jesus Christ.
